Class Popover

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.UserInterface
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A osu.Framework.Graphics.UserInterface.Popover is a transient view that appears above other on-screen content. It typically is activated by another control and includes an arrow pointing to the location from which it emerged. (loosely paraphrasing: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/ios/views/popovers/)

Content

The content of this container. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children and all methods that mutate osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children (e.g. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Add(`0) and osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Remove(`0,System.Boolean)) are forwarded to the content. By default a container's content is itself, in which case osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children refers to osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.InternalChildren. This property is useful for containers that require internal children that should not be exposed to the outside world, e.g. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.ScrollContainer`1.

protected override Container<Drawable> Content { get; }

Property Value

Container<Drawable>

HandleNonPositionalInput

Whether this osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable handles non-positional input. This value is true by default if osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Handle(osu.Framework.Input.Events.UIEvent) or any non-positional (e.g. keyboard related) "On-" input methods are overridden.

Whether to block the event from propagating to other osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawables in the hierarchy.

Remarks

Repeat events can only be invoked on the osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawables that received a previous non-repeat osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.OnKeyDown(osu.Framework.Input.Events.KeyDownEvent) invocation which are still present in the input queue (via osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.BuildNonPositionalInputQueue(System.Collections.Generic.List{osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable},System.Boolean)) when the repeat occurs.
